{{Quote|No one has ever left this house hungry.''"<br />"''Well, one person did once, but Mom chased him down and dragged him back in.|Sola Naberrie and Padmé Amidala, about their mother's zeal as a hostess|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Jobal Naberrie''' (neé '''Thule''') was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was the daughter of [[Ryoo Thule]], the wife of [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]], and the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola Naberrie]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. She was also the maternal grandmother of [[Ryoo Naberrie/Legends|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], as well as [[Twin/Legends|twins]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].

==Biography==
[[File:Jobal_Naberrie.jpg|thumb|left|190px|Jobal at dinner with her family]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Jobal Naberrie was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[76 BBY/Legends|76 BBY]]<ref name="FF140" /> on the [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] Territories. Her [[Parent/Legends|mother]] went by the name of [[Ryoo Thule|Ryoo]], after a [[Ryoo|flower]] that grew in the vicinity of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], but her father's identity was forgotten in the passage of [[Time/Legends|time]]. On her bountiful [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the young Jobal began with a secure and happy childhood.<ref name="FF80" />

When she became a young adult, Jobal met [[Ruwee Naberrie/Legends|Ruwee Naberrie]], a teenaged member of the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]], a non-profit resettlement agency. Impressed by Naberrie's social acumen, Jobal fell in love with him shortly after they met.<ref name="FF80" /> Unbeknownst to the young woman, her mother and Ruwee Naberrie's mother [[Winama Naberrie|Winama]] knew each other well and had been plotting for an arranged [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] between their offsprings. The two mothers were genuinely surprised when they learned that Jobal and Ruwee had actually fallen in love.<ref name="FF140" />

[[File:JobalNaberrie-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|150px|Jobal during the Clone wars]]
After their marriage in [[51 BBY/Legends|51 BBY]], Ruwee and Jobal Naberrie played an instrumental role in the founding of a [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Padmé Amidala)/Legends|new village]] in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] close to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Naboo. While Jobal Naberrie and her husband intended to spend the rest of their lives among that new community, they took a new turn when she got pregnant. In [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]], Naberrie gave life to a first daughter whom she named [[Sola Naberrie/Legends|Sola]], and then [[46 BBY/Legends|four years later]] to another girl named [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé]]. With two other [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] to feed, Jobal Naberrie and her husband started reconsidering their future.<ref name="FF80" />

After Padmé received impressive scores to an aptitude test, Jobal and Ruwee moved to Theed in order to offer their children a chance at a higher education and richer life. Jobal was a very hospitable housewife and offered all her guests lavish meals. In Theed, she voluntarily worked in a variety of social service roles helping the underprivileged. Her way of life instilled very strong compassion and selflessness into their children, which was obvious from Padmé's career.<ref name="FF80" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Jobal, along with her husband who was the [[President/Legends|President]] of the Refugee Relief Movement at the time, had the surprising visit of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] at the RRM's [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] headquarters. Palpatine had come to try and convince the Naberries to have Padmé run for the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]. Ruwee and Jobal were pretty hesitant at first, not wanting their just-turned-thirteen-year-old daughter to go through all of this and lose.<ref name="SWDP" />

After being [[Princess of Theed]] for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Padmé was elected [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]] with a landslide victory.<ref name="SD">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref> During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]], Ruwee and Jobal were arrested and sent to [[Prison/Legends|jail]].<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> Eight years later, Padmé ended her second term as Queen and, at the request of her successor, Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]], became the new Senatorial representative of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

[[File:Funeral-Naberries.png|thumb|left|240px|Jobal and her husband at Padmé's funeral procession]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], several [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempts]] were made on Padmé. Jobal was deeply worried about her daughter's safety and kept reminding her that it was maybe time to think of herself and have a life of her own. In the same period, she had the occasion to meet her future son-in-law, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="AOTCDS" />

[[19 BBY/Legends|Three years later]], Jobal, along with the rest of her [[Naberrie family/Legends|family]] and thousands of other mourners, attended Padmé's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had ended.<ref name="Episode III" />

In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Padmé's funeral, Jobal's mother [[Ryoo Thule|Ryoo]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] after the latter interrogated her about Padmé and her mysterious pregnancy.<ref name="TLofTJDoN">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jobal Naberrie was portrayed by [[Trisha Noble]] in deleted scenes of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], as well as in a brief scene of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/news20030904.html|text=Casting Update: More in the Family}}</ref>
